$comment: Configuration, NOT cached conventions. Nothing here records where components live, what
they are named, or how props are shaped — those are derived from the target repository at
generation time, because a written-down derivable fact is the one thing nothing checks.
If you find yourself adding `componentRoot` here, that is the trap; add a MAP.md row instead.

memory.$comment: Where the generator's memory lives INSIDE the target repository. A configuration choice, not a convention — it has to be told, it cannot be derived.

generate.$comment: notesMode 'ask' asks before writing a note; 'auto' writes when the gate in figma-astro-note passes; 'off' never writes. 'ask' until the gate has been observed to reject the right things.

fidelity.$comment: Pixel-audit tolerances. A Figma frame is measured at its own width; anything beyond that is a responsive decision the frame does not describe.

verify.$comment: Gates to run after generating. Names are resolved against the TARGET repo's package.json at run time and skipped with a warning if absent — the list of gates is itself a convention that moves.

fingerprint.$comment: Re-baselining is deliberately manual: a change announced once and then auto-accepted is a change nobody saw.
